# Stage183 — Full-real affine optimum of the external N14 ternary IID model

**Status:** author-level exact derivation + executed local rational certificate, NOT canonical Source Result, independent review, Foundation admission or native P000/X6 theorem. Date: 2026-10-27. GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE_V1 frozen main@8ec98188025f60aafe48055520ba3a57c29cdb2c; Enterprise Math control/source initially main@fd157124db7dde6d7a07566e4004fb5286240e03. Frozen predecessor Stage182 proof at branch commit 1dcd2cabc6e6e8ddf70628c68c7cf2dbede4e23a, path research_notes/n14_aux_iid_affine_182_r2_author_20261027/PROOF_STAGE182.md.

## 1. Model, theorem and boundary

Observations have alphabet {0,1,2}, N=14, independent and identically distributed with

    P=(1/8,1/24,5/6), Q=(1/12,1/12,5/6).

A strategy may randomize its stopping and P/Q decision using the **entire ordered observation history**, but stops by n=14. Let eP=P(decide Q), eQ=Q(decide P), tP=E_P[tau], tQ=E_Q[tau] and V14(alpha)=min max(tP,tQ) over strategies with both errors <=alpha.

Prior verified author-level endpoint:
    alpha182=6293781278910356391787/17990936586642819907584
    V182=50134637360540821877021/4497734146660704976896.

Set
    K183=2983556187/15076502
    L183=1477646456/7538251
    M183=K183+L183=5938849099/15076502
    Delta183=259127378125/867618469649055744.

**Theorem (all real parameters):** For every real delta with 0<=delta<=Delta183, including every irrational delta,

    V14(alpha182+delta)=V182-M183*delta.

Thus the new exact endpoint is

    alpha183=6293786652175669191787/17990936586642819907584
    V183=50134108209086100977021/4497734146660704976896.

For every alpha>alpha183, the **same Stage183** affine Bellman lower support H183-M183*alpha is strictly less than V14(alpha). This does not assert the value function terminates or has a jump.

## 2. Bellman inequality valid for arbitrary ordered-history strategies

A count state is c=(n,a,b) for n observations including a occurrences of 0, b of 1. The likelihood ratio of any ordered history with those counts is ell(c)=Q(history)/P(history)=2^(a+b)/3^a. For fixed positive K183,L183, define J=tP+K183*eQ+L183*eP. A final P-decision costs K183*ell in conditional P units, a final Q-decision costs L183 and continuing costs one unit of P-time plus its P-weighted next value. Therefore backward Bellman induction gives

    B(c)=min{K183*ell(c), L183, 1+sum_i P_i*B(next_i(c))}  (n<14)
    B(c)=min{K183*ell(c), L183}                       (n=14).

Even a history-dependent policy cannot beat this minimum at an ordered prefix. IID sufficiency only lets the *value* be indexed by counts; it is not a claim that all path provenance may be discarded for every observer or future operation.

All sum_(n=0)^14 binom(n+2,2)=680 count states were enumerated exactly with rational arithmetic. Precisely two ties exist:

    S=(9,0,1): choose Q / continue,
    X=(11,5,2): choose P / continue.

The 1238 alternative strict action gaps are positive, minimum 5926103/180918024; no negative gap. The root is

    H183=B(0,0,0)=61508771764230260243523613/412949318370301380132864.

For any alpha-feasible full-history strategy,

    max(tP,tQ)>=tP>=H183-K183*eQ-L183*eP>=H183-(K183+L183)*alpha.       (1)

## 3. Full-real attaining primal family

Use unique Bellman minimizers at non-ties. At S choose Q with probability s and continue otherwise. At X choose P with probability x and continue otherwise. The ties cannot both lie on any one history: from S at n=9 with a=0 to X at n=11 with a=5 would require five new zeros in only two steps; X cannot precede S since its n is larger. Thus each of (eP,eQ,tP,tQ) is **affine** in (s,x), with no sx term.

We separately computed all four deterministic corners by memoized Fraction suffix DP and by a nonmerged ordered-history DFS with integer path numerators. For P the numerators per letter with denominator 24 are (3,1,20), for Q the denominators/numerators are 12 and (1,1,10). P and Q positive path masses and branch multiplicities were never signed-canceled. Complete DFS node counts at (s,x)=(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1) are 238912, 215152, 238480, 214720, totaling **907264**; the two independent algorithms agree exactly on every corner vector. First-hit S has 9 ordered prefixes with P-mass 390625/4478976 and Q-mass 390625/2239488. First-hit X has 1980 ordered prefixes with P-mass 34375/679477248 and Q-mass 34375/1289945088.

Solving the exact affine constraint eP=eQ yields

    s(x)=21907098415879349/37833811200000000 + (2580303/5254696000)*x.       (2)

Every real x in [0,1] gives legal coins: 0<s(0)<s(1)=21925676597479349/37833811200000000<1. At x=0, the balanced errors and P-time equal alpha182, alpha182, V182, and the S coin matches the Stage182 right endpoint. At x=1, they equal alpha183, alpha183, V183. The common error alpha(x) is strictly increasing, P-time strictly decreasing and all observables affine in x. Thus EVERY real alpha between the endpoints is attained by a legal real x, including irrational alpha.

P-time exceeds Q-time strictly throughout because their difference is affine and positive at both ends:

    x=0: 166057085648349625295/562216768332588122112
    x=1: 166070625793116812795/562216768332588122112.

Each action is Bellman minimizing, so tP+K183*eQ+L183*eP=H183. With balanced errors and tP=max(tP,tQ), equality holds throughout inequality (1), proving the theorem. The reference verification program and certificate summary store the four exact corners and the complete rational assertions. The locally **executed original** and full logs are in the portable research ZIP; the repository's reference verifier is separately source-derived and should be run by the recipient for independent reproduction.

## 4. Strict right-end support sharpness

With finite 14-step alphabet, randomized history-contingent strategies form a finite product of compact simplices and all observables are continuous, hence the optimum is attained. If equality to the same Stage183 lower line held at any alpha>alpha183, K183,L183>0 would force eP=eQ=alpha and Bellman-minimizing actions everywhere reached, in addition to tP>=tQ. All non-tie action gaps are strict. Arbitrary prefix-dependent coins at S or X have exactly the observable effect of aggregate coins s,x: within each tie's fixed count class, Q(path)/P(path) is constant and the ties never co-occur along a history. Error balance again imposes (2), and the common alpha(x) increases on the legal x-interval [0,1], reaching its maximum alpha183 at x=1. Contradiction. By attainment the support gap is strict for alpha>alpha183.

## 5. BRC observer, limits, and new dual-only frontier

Reuse state **REUSE_APPLIED** for the existing finite positive-rational BRC carrier: labeled ordered branch multiplicity and independent P/Q masses are exact; count-state suffix compression is valid only for the declared IID Bellman observer. It does not assert phase/signed cancellation, all-future path quotient, unbounded-horizon bounds, native Heartbeat/BRC-Shor arithmetic or P000 X6 cell dynamics. The locked ACTIVE worldview's six native axes, three-dimensional slices, native 120-degree angle, triadic primitive balance, and residual-fidelity constraints remain untouched.
